name: manual_48fe0b
claim: A compatibility manifest skip allowance counts every skipped test, so a capability-gated test module must be not collected (collect_ignore in a package conftest) rather than importorskip'd where the capability is absent; one module-level skip failed every oracle cell.
conditions: skip-allowance importorskip collect_ignore max_skipped oracle-cell capability

decisions.notes: PR with a module-level importorskip failed six oracle cells (production 2>1, core-r3 2>1, policy-r3 6>5); moving it behind a conftest gate restored zero skip delta.

rationale: PR with a module-level importorskip failed six oracle cells (production 2>1, core-r3 2>1, policy-r3 6>5); moving it behind a conftest gate restored zero skip delta.
